title: SQL executed from a concatenated string in kotlin — review required
description: SQLiteDatabase.execSQL runs a statement string with no parameter slot. Concatenating a request value into it makes the value part of the SQL grammar, so a quote or UNION changes the statement. The rule flags the concatenation; whether the value is attacker-controlled is a review decision.
remediation: Use execSQL with bindArgs placeholders, or move the write behind a Room DAO with typed parameters.
limitation: Lexical: matches execSQL calls containing + concatenation on one line.

tests.line: # audit: db.execSQL("UPDATE users SET name = '" + name + "'") present
# verified: db.execSQL("UPDATE users SET name = ?", arrayOf(name))
